scope:
Audit a finite decoder rewrite and a functional-encoding obstruction.

The 34-transition rewrite is a literal finite-window certificate. The
residual collision concerns the ORIGINAL register program at two PCs. It
does not claim that the subsequently mutated TM follows those residuals.
Additional literal mutant prefixes are saved separately to expose that gap.
No blank reachability, nonhalting, lower bound, or equivalence is asserted.

literal_window_certificate.proof_scope: For every tape agreeing with the stated input on [-11,6], regardless of every exterior cell. Induction on the listed34 literal rows proves the endpoint; no register-box macro is used.

general_residual_formulas.domain: t,k in N; n in N positive; s2=0; other primary registers fixed
general_residual_formulas.nonfactorization: No function E of the expected primary register tuple alone satisfies G=E after F for all domain inputs. The two recorded inputs have equal F and unequal G.
general_residual_formulas.limits: Does not exclude encodings depending on spare suffixes, saved history, additional invariants, entry recodings, or nonfunctional relations. These formulas describe original residuals, not the subsequent mutated TM.
